bullets.text: The Rs 264.55 crore Velachery flyover contract in Chennai has been officially cancelled, and the office should monitor developments regarding the project.
A 36-year-old gym trainer was arrested in Chennai for stalking and threatening a woman software firm owner, and the office should track police follow-ups.
Residents of JJ Nagar in Pazhaverkadu are requesting their Ponneri MLA to visit due to a lack of basic facilities, and the office should arrange a site visit.
Gummidipoondi has returned to normal after surpassing Delhi in air pollution caused by fuel combustion and road dust, and the district team should monitor air quality levels.
Chief Minister Vijay expressed anger over alleged corruption involving AI, and the portfolio team should monitor statements and investigations related to this matter.
IIT Madras in Chennai will host the 6th India Internet Governance Forum on November 30, 2026, and the office should prepare for delegate coordination.
Vel Tech TBI hosted the fifth Startup and Investor Summit in Chennai with over 200 startups attending, and the portfolio team should engage with participating entrepreneurs.
A DMK leader moved the High Court for a CBI probe into a collector's complaint against TVK MLA Arul Vignesh, and the office should watch court proceedings.

takeaways: The 264.55 crore rupee Velachery flyover project contract was officially cancelled after being awarded last year.
